title: confed push result
description: The `result` of `confed push --json`. With --dry-run nothing is uploaded and the lists describe the plan. `push --interactive` is the one variant with a different shape: cancelling at the prompt returns {"cancelled": true}, and an empty interactive plan returns only the three page lists.

pushed.description: Existing pages updated on the server.

created.description: Pages that had no `confed:` block and were created on the server.

deleted.description: Pages deleted on the server. Only ever non-empty with --allow-delete.

attachments_uploaded.description: Sidecar-relative paths of attachments uploaded, or that a --dry-run would upload.

attachments_deleted.description: Sidecar-relative paths of attachments deleted on the server. Only ever non-empty with --allow-delete.

comments_added.description: Ids of comments posted from `confed:new` markers in comment sidecars.

comments_pending.description: Comment work a --dry-run found. Absent on a real push, which reports ids in `comments_added`.

skipped.description: Work push refused: unresolved conflicts, tampered frontmatter, a stale base, or a local deletion (of a page or an attachment) without --allow-delete.

failed.description: Pages the server rejected. Non-empty means exit 8.

page_id.description: Empty string for a page created by this very run's dry run.

ops.description: Which aspects of the page change.
